ValidationRule.description: Prevents assigning a Unit to a Booking if the selected Unit is already associated with an active Booking record (i.e., its status is 'Reserved' or 'Sold'). This ensures that a Unit can only be assigned to one active Booking at a time.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Unit_Id__c ), NOT(ISBLANK(Unit_Id__c )), OR( TEXT( Unit_Id__r.Status__c ) = 'Sold', TEXT(Unit_Id__r.Status__c) = 'Reserved' ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Residential_Sales_Booking" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Unit is already assigned to an active Booking. Please select a different available Unit.
